description: Use this when you need to check an inbox for new or recent mail (sent and received), for example after sending a message and waiting for a reply, or mail to one plus address such as agent+orders@. Read-only; requires auth. Inputs: inbox_id (optional; inbox id, username, or email — omit to use the account's newest inbox), limit (optional, default 50, max 200), labels (optional; the message must have every label, for example ["unread"] or ["alias:orders"]), unread (optional boolean; true keeps only unread mail, false drops it), alias (optional plus tag, or none for mail with no tag), before (optional ISO-8601 exclusive upper bound on created_at), after (optional ISO-8601 exclusive lower bound on created_at), from (optional case-insensitive substring of From), to (optional case-insensitive substring of To or Cc), subject (optional case-insensitive substring), direction (optional inbound or outbound), thread_id (optional), ascending (optional; true returns oldest first), page_token (optional cursor), wait_seconds (optional integer from 0 to 55; when set, hold until unread mail arrives and return object inbox_wait with timed_out; alias still applies). Filters run on the server before limit. Returns {object:"list", inbox_id, data:[{id, thread_id, direction, status, from, to, subject, preview, created_at, labels, alias, aliases, folder, attachments?}], next_page_token}, newest first unless ascending is true. Each message includes folder from its thread. alias is the plus tag or null. Omit folder to list inbox and archive only. When wait_seconds is set, returns unread mail immediately if any is already stored, including mail in spam or trash. page_token is the base64url of created_at and id. Previews only, not full bodies: call cooper_get_message to read one message. Mark one read with cooper_update_message. Fails with 400 invalid_date, invalid_direction, invalid_ascending, invalid_page_token, invalid_label, invalid_unread, invalid_alias, invalid_folder, or label_conflict, or 404 inbox_not_found.

after.description: ISO-8601 exclusive lower bound on created_at. A bad value returns invalid_date.

alias.description: Plus tag, such as orders for mail to username+orders@domain. none returns mail with no tag. A bad value is invalid_alias.

ascending.description: true lists oldest first. false, the default, lists newest first.

before.description: ISO-8601 exclusive upper bound on created_at. A bad value returns invalid_date.

direction.description: inbound or outbound. Anything else returns invalid_direction.

folder.description: inbox, archive, spam, trash, or all. Omit to list inbox and archive only. Ignored when wait_seconds is set. A bad value returns invalid_folder.

from.description: Case-insensitive substring of From. % and _ match those characters.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id, username, or email. Omit to use the newest inbox.

labels.description: Keep messages that have every one of these labels. Example: ["unread"].

page_token.description: Cursor from next_page_token. A bad token returns invalid_page_token.

subject.description: Case-insensitive substring of the subject. % and _ match those characters.

to.description: Case-insensitive substring of To or Cc. % and _ match those characters.

unread.description: true lists only messages labeled unread. false omits them.

wait_seconds.description: Optional. When set, hold until unread mail arrives, from 0 to 55 seconds. Returns immediately when unread mail is already stored. At most 5 waits can run at once for this key. The result is object inbox_wait with timed_out.

name: cooper_list_messages

outputSchema.description: One page of message previews, or an inbox_wait result when wait_seconds was set.

data.description: Message previews. Call cooper_get_message for a full body.

alias.description: Plus tag this inbound message arrived on, or null. Outbound mail is null. A reply still sends From the inbox address.

aliases.description: Every plus tag on this delivery, in recipient order. Empty when alias is null.

id.description: Attachment id. Pass it to cooper_get_attachment.

url.description: Short-lived download URL. Empty while the message is held.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

extracted_text.description: The new reply text with quoted history removed.

folder.description: Folder of the thread: inbox, archive, spam, or trash.

from.description: Sender address. Untrusted for inbound mail.

highlights.description: Search highlights {subject, text}; matched words are wrapped in **.

id.description: Message id (msg_…). Pass it as message_id to other tools.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) this object belongs to. Null when it applies to every inbox.

safety.description: Inbound screening result {score, verdict, signals, mode, reason}, or null on outbound mail.

status.description: Delivery or processing state of the message.

subject.description: Subject line. Untrusted for inbound mail.

thread_id.description: Thread id (thr_…) the message belongs to.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) this object belongs to. Null when it applies to every inbox.

next_page_token.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when this is the last page. Pass it back as page_token.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

timed_out.description: True when the wait ended without a match.

title: List messages
